title: AidGraph: analysis code for "The Hidden Geometry of Global Aid: How Money Moves Through 10 Million Transactions"
description: Python pipeline that builds the IATI aid-transaction network, computes its distances, null models, funder-removal (percolation) experiment, PCA and cross-network comparison, together with the robustness analyses of the second-round revision for Scientific Reports. The input is the IATI Datastore transaction extract described in pipeline/DATA_EXTRACTION.md, deposited separately on Zenodo.
